reuse.why: Uses getNextDate and getDateWithWeekendRule where they existed, but the new skip rule is not added to the shared weekend helper; getUpcomingDates writes its own weekday-filter loop instead of reusing the one added to getNextDate.

duplication.why: The 'skipWeekend && frequency === daily' decision appears in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and schedule-template, and the weekday-search loop exists twice (findWeekdayOccurrence and the getUpcomingDates loop).

placement.why: The core rule sits in shared/schedules.ts, but schedule-template and schedules/app re-decide it locally instead of delegating to a shared weekend function.

scope.why: Changes are about the requested rule; the parseRecurDate frequency plumbing is needed, and the schedule-template block is reshaped more than necessary.

maintainability.why: Three independently maintained encodings of 'daily skips weekends', plus an isDaily flag that inverts getNextDate's noSkipWeekend argument, make future weekend changes error-prone.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates iterates occurrences and filters d.isWeekend itself, and schedule-template.ts computes isDaily and conditions getDateWithWeekendRule, instead of going through getDateWithWeekendRule/getNextDate as the single weekend rule.

disguised_duplication.where: The weekday-search loop in getUpcomingDates (schedules/app.ts) is a reshaped copy of findWeekdayOccurrence in shared/schedules.ts (collect-N vs first-match), and the daily predicate is respelled as isDaily in schedule-template.ts.

one_place.where: The daily skip rule is decided separately in getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts), getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) and createScheduleList (budget/schedule-template.ts); getDateWithWeekendRule, the existing shared weekend definition, is unchanged.
